item.title: Radio Outage
item.description: Sorry, over the Thanksgiving weekend, it appears the radio crashed. The easiest way to prevent this is to keep a better eye on it, and to also start having DJs be able to access it. Konso will be one of the first, and we’ll go from there. Sorry again!

item.title: Listener’s Lounge Opened!
item.description: Hey all, Helkaweth here! Just sending out a notice that we’ve opened our very own Listener’s Lounge! Here, you can see what’s playing, what has been played, chat, and watch the streaming video! Click here for the listener’s lounge! More upgrades to come! Take care and as always, Helkaweth
